status: predeclared literature assumptions; not measured FULLSET assignments
authorization: Wang: no additional height records; use literature assumptions and height sensitivity analysis
policy: Report every scenario, never select by observed flux skill.
Temperature and humidity remain co-located; independently vary their common height and wind height.
Meteorology values are reinterpreted at each candidate height; do not apply a second height correction.
Hold initial state, roughness, PFT, soil, parameters, forcing and numerical criteria fixed across height scenarios.
Full-column H/LE/GPP/NEE and state responses remain necessary; transfer-coefficient sensitivity alone is not flux validation.

roughness_assumption.note: Explicit provisional site geometry, not independently measured roughness; fixed within the height analysis.

CN-Cng.assumption: Highest reported T/RH layer as baseline; 2 m EC wind as provisional forcing wind. Wind 4/6 m are explicit mast-height sensitivity scenarios, not verified wind sensor records.

CN-Qia.assumption: Highest reported meteorological level as baseline; alternative above-canopy levels are not claims about actual consolidated forcing fields.

CN-Cha.assumption: Highest reported meteorological level as baseline; 32 m coincides with BIF canopy top and probes the limitations of a MOST roughness-layer approximation.

initial_sensitivity_scope: Fixed recorded canopy heights; annual/seasonal canopy-height change is a separate uncertainty.

execution_plan.scope: Initial complete-column height sensitivity on fixed warm-season calibration/initialization windows; cold start, not site acceptance or equilibrium spinup.
execution_plan.parameter_policy: Explicit nominal soil/plant parameters are held fixed; the initial sensitivity isolates height uncertainty and does not claim measured site hydraulics or biomass. All 27 cases retained including any failures.
execution_plan.initial_conditions: First-window shallow TS/SWC extended uniformly to the common 2 m column; SWE and canopy water zero; identical within each site. Active summer initial deciduous leaves are an assumption, not spinup.
outputs: all scenarios minus predeclared baseline with near-zero absolute differences
